Theorem
1. ch6:6.32

If $f$ is a smooth local distance function on an open subset $U$ of a Riemannian manifold, then \[ abla _{\operatorname {grad}f}(\operatorname {grad}f)=0. \] Consequently, every integral curve of $\operatorname {grad}f$ is a unit-speed geodesic.
